conf.description: Veritas NetBackup audit, OCSF v1.0.0 JSON rendering, direct route. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: shape the OCSF object at the core worker group into the same schema as the native-text branch (status_id outcome lookup, actor.user split, _time from epoch-ms time); CATEGORY/ACTION lift out of the mapper-driven unmapped object is a documented gap since key names there are site-configurable

conf.comment: NetBackup audit events, OCSF v1.0.0 JSON rendering (SYSLOG_AUDIT_USE_OCSF_FORMAT=1), direct route. Converges on the same target schema as the native-text audit pipeline. NetBackup CATEGORY/ACTION are NOT lifted out of the mapper-driven `unmapped` object here (site-configurable key names -- see README gap); the whole object is carried in netbackup.audit.unmapped instead.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, format and known gap
Direct-carry renames: OCSF severity_id (0-6 scale, different from the anomaly feed's risk_score) and product/vendor metadata
event.outcome from OCSF status_id (1 Success, 2 Failure, 0 Unknown) where the mapper populates it
Stage the actor.user identity string (present only in classes with an actor)
Custom-namespace copies of the OCSF class/category/activity/type identifiers, schema version, and the mapper-shaped unmapped remainder (CATEGORY/ACTION not lifted out of it -- see README)
Event time from OCSF `time` (epoch milliseconds) into _time, not @timestamp (platform constraint)
Set event.dataset (no hyphen, platform constraint) -- shared with the native-text branch
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
